description: comment-discipline — SessionStart injects the no-ephemeral-comments authoring directive on startup, resume, clear, fork, and post-compaction (so it survives compaction rather than being quietly dropped mid-session). SessionStart reaches the main session only, so subagents — which write plenty of code — get the rule two other ways: the directive asks dispatching agents to relay it into code-writing dispatch prompts, and PostToolUse on the edit tools injects it once per subagent on its first edit. The hook cannot see whether the relay happened, so it always injects; a relayed subagent gets the rule twice. Silent when the config sets enabled:false; with no config at all it emits a one-line nudge to run /comment-discipline init.
